steps.text: Before the four batches of AI features, I set the bar: I would check them myself in the simulator, and the digital twin and the staff and manager devices all had to work.
Checking the last batch that evening, I found that the camera on the two demo phones could not be closed once opened. I asked for every phone function to be fixed properly, not just that one.

steps.text: Claude Code clicked through every role and screen on both phones and fixed 13 problems. The camera had three causes: a global :active style, a camera that starts asynchronously and a frame without camera permission.

design.title: Design
design.sub: The rules behind this page, drawn with its own styles. Colors and sizes are read from its stylesheet as you look, so they always match.
design.colorWhy: Near-black, not black, so the glows have room to fade. Light mode is its own white design, not the dark one turned inside out.
design.contrastNote: Body text needs 4.5:1 and large text 3:1, in both modes; the tests measure it on every change.
design.typeWhy: System fonts only: nothing to download, and Chinese uses the system's own fonts. Figures are tabular, so the clock does not jitter.
design.shapeWhy: Cards have 16 px corners, pills are fully round and app tiles round a quarter of their size. Pills are for things you press, cards for things you read.
design.cardWhy: A 1 px gradient edge and a faint glow at the top left instead of heavy shadows; in dark mode there are no shadows at all.
design.cardText: Gradient edge, faint glow, 16 px corners.
design.buttonWhy: One indigo primary action per card; everything else is a quiet outline.
design.iconWhy: Line drawings on a 24 px grid with a 1.6 px stroke, indigo to teal: the same family as the README's app tiles.
design.motionWhy: Apps grow from where you tapped, from 96% to full size with a fade, in 200 ms. Motion shows where things come from; only the planets keep moving.
design.curve: The easing curve, cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1): quick to start, gentle to land.
design.reduced: With reduced motion nothing slides or turns: the planets stand still and panels simply fade.

about.title: About this site
about.intro: One HTML file, built from a few data files, that works everything out in your browser. The numbers below come from the build and from the last full run of the tests.
about.requestsNote: the guestbook connects only after you click it
about.astroIntro: The planets, the Sun and the Moon are worked out here from published formulas, then compared with JPL Horizons, NASA's ephemeris service.

astroRows.planets: Planets' positions around the Sun (the other six)
astroRows.altaz: Height and direction in the sky: the Sun and planets
astroRows.altazMoon: Height and direction in the sky: the Moon

about.astroFoot: Reference values fetched from JPL Horizons on {fetched}, for {dates} dates from {from} to {to}, with skies over Greenwich, Beijing and Sydney. {passed} of {n} checks within their limits; node scripts/check_astro.mjs runs them again.
privacy: This site sets no cookies and counts no visitors.

Your settings (appearance, language, motion, parallax, the clock, the Sky's city, standby, the wallpaper's middle), the star game's best times and whether you have seen the tour stay in this browser's local storage.
"Use my location" asks your browser only when you click it; the place is used for the chart and not kept.
Sound and the phone's compass start only when you switch them on.
The guestbook connects to giscus.app and GitHub only after you click to open it.
A Content Security Policy makes the browser itself refuse anything else from the network.
a11y: Everything works from the keyboard: Tab goes through the planets and every control, and ? lists the shortcuts.
Reduced motion (your system's setting, or Quick settings) stops the planets and every animation.
Buttons, pictures and the clock have names a screen reader can read; panels keep focus inside and give it back when they close.
Text has a contrast of at least 4.5:1 in dark and light mode, and your system's increase-contrast setting makes lines and text stronger.
about.a11yFoot: Checked automatically in headless Chrome on every change: focus rings, the tab order, reduced motion, names and contrast. If something does not work for you, please tell me: {email}.
about.draftsIntro: Design drafts, never released; each one led to the next.

steps.text: 四批 AI 功能开工前，我先定了验收标准：做完后我亲自在模拟器里验证，数字孪生、员工和管理层的设备都要正常工作。
当晚验收最后一批时，我发现两部演示手机的摄像头打开后关不掉。我要求把手机上的所有功能彻底修一遍，而不只是修这一个。

steps.text: Claude Code 用真实点击把两部手机的每个岗位、每个页面都走了一遍，修了 13 个问题。摄像头的问题有三个原因：全局的 :active 样式、摄像头异步打开、iframe 没有摄像头权限。
steps.href: {{storewright.repo}}/blob/main/docs/decisions/0024-store-ai-batch4.md#14-收尾走查发现的问题与修复

design.title: 设计规范
design.sub: 这个页面背后的规则，用页面自己的样式现场画出来。颜色和尺寸是从它的样式表里读出来的，所以总是一致。
design.colorWhy: 用近黑而不是纯黑，光晕才有地方慢慢淡出。浅色模式是单独设计的白色版本，不是把深色反过来。
design.contrastNote: 正文至少 4.5:1，大字至少 3:1，深浅两种模式都一样；每次改动测试都会量一遍。
design.typeWhy: 只用系统字体：不用下载，中文用系统自带的字体。数字等宽，时钟跳动时不会晃。
design.shapeWhy: 卡片圆角 16 px，胶囊全圆，应用图标的圆角是边长的四分之一。胶囊用于可以按的东西，卡片用于要读的内容。
design.cardWhy: 用 1 px 的渐变描边和左上角淡淡的光，而不是厚重的阴影；深色模式里完全没有阴影。
design.cardText: 渐变描边、淡淡的光、16 px 圆角。
design.buttonWhy: 每张卡片最多一个靛蓝的主要按钮，其余都是低调的描边按钮。
design.iconWhy: 24 px 网格上的线条图标，描边 1.6 px，从靛蓝渐变到青色，和 README 里的应用图标是一家。
design.motionWhy: 应用从你点的地方展开：从 96% 放大到原大并淡入，用时 200 毫秒。动效只用来说明东西从哪里来；一直在动的只有行星。
design.curve: 缓动曲线 cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1)：起步快，落地轻。
design.reduced: 打开“减弱动态效果”后什么都不滑也不转：行星停下，面板只是淡入淡出。

about.intro: 一个 HTML 文件，由几份数据文件生成，所有内容都在你的浏览器里算出来。下面的数字来自生成页面时的测量和最近一次完整的测试。

privacy: 本站不设 cookie，也不统计访客。
你的设置（外观、语言、动态效果、视差、时钟、星空里的城市、待机、壁纸中间放什么）、星座游戏的最好成绩，以及你是否看过导览，都只存在这个浏览器的本地存储里。
“使用我的位置”只在你点了以后才问浏览器；这个位置只用来画星图，不会保存。
声音和手机的指南针都要你自己打开才会启动。
留言簿要等你点开以后才连接 giscus.app 和 GitHub。
内容安全策略（CSP）让浏览器自己拒绝其他一切网络请求。
a11y: 所有功能都能用键盘操作：按 Tab 依次经过行星和每个控件，按 ? 查看全部快捷键。
打开“减弱动态效果”（系统设置或快捷设置）后，行星停下，所有动画都不再播放。
按钮、图片和时钟都有读屏软件能读出的名称；面板打开时焦点留在面板里，关闭后回到原处。
深色和浅色模式下文字对比度都至少 4.5:1；系统打开“增强对比度”时，线条和文字会更清楚。
about.a11yFoot: 每次改动都在无界面的 Chrome 里自动检查：焦点框、Tab 顺序、减弱动态效果、名称和对比度。如果哪里不好用，请告诉我：{email}。

game.head: 试一试：拣货路线
game.intro: Storewright 小型门店里的六件商品。走到每个货架，再回到推车处，然后和 Storewright 的路线比一比。
game.how: 点一下货架或地面就会走过去，也可以用方向键。
game.boardAria: 门店地图。推车在右前方。方向键从一个停靠点走到下一个。
game.statusBack: 都拣齐了：回到推车处 · 已走 {m} 米
game.result: 你走了 {you} 米，Storewright 的路线是 {tsp} 米。
game.same: 和 Storewright 的路线一样长。
game.better: 比 Storewright 的路线短 {d} 米。
game.worse: 比 Storewright 的路线长 {d} 米。
game.sshape: 按通道一条条走（常见做法）：{s} 米。
game.rule: Storewright 的规则：每次先去最近的货架，再用 2-opt 把能缩短路程的一段反过来走（routeTsp，同一套代码，在这里运行）。
game.foot: 门店、货架和路线规则都来自 Storewright 的开源代码（提交 {commit}）；里面的一切都是合成的。

lab.head: 如果……会怎样
lab.intro: 改一改上面这一天的设置，用 Storewright 自己的仿真代码在你的浏览器里重跑一遍。
lab.pickersHint: 现在最忙的时段 {n} 人；其他有拣货的时段增减同样的人数，至少 1 人。
lab.peakVal: 高峰订单是平时的 {x} 倍
lab.peakVal1: 高峰订单和平时一样多
lab.peakHint: 现在 ×1。最忙的时段（{hours}）多分或少分全天的订单；全天的预期总量不变。
lab.failed: 这个浏览器里仿真没能运行。
lab.tableCap: 这一天现在的结果和改动后的结果
lab.announce: 改动后：按时备好 {onTime}，平均取货等待 {wait}。现在：{nowOnTime}，{nowWait}。
lab.small: 数据是合成的。两列用同一个随机种子（当天日期），结果只说明这个模型，不代表真实门店。
lab.code: 仿真用的是 Storewright 自己的代码（提交 {commit}），按 AGPL-3.0 许可。
